answer_1.quote: we conducted a 'toy example' of an evaluation of five popular LLMs, with regards to seven harmful behaviours from the taxonomy, in the context of creative content generation.
answer_1.outputs: generated responses to creative prompts (e.g., storylines, poems, character descriptions)

answer_2.quote: we use Gemini Pro (henceforth GemEval) to evaluate the outputs of five test models... We also complement and validate our use of GemEval... using a low-compute heuristic, namely n-gram matching.

answer_3.quote: we use Gemini Pro (henceforth GemEval) to evaluate the outputs of five test models... using targeted prompts.
methods: targeted prompts for harmful behavior evaluation

answer_4.quote: To ensure that our use of GemEval to evaluate model responses had reasonable validity, we also manually annotated approximately 20 responses from each of the test models for each of the seven harmful behaviours of interest.
answer_4.guideline: annotation guidelines being a slightly modified version of the prompt given to GemEval, asking for a binary response.
